cim: Silicon Valley nerds are becoming masters of war, money and politics
cim_eredeti: Silicon Valley nerds are becoming masters of war, money and politics
szoveg_eredeti:
Every era crowns its own supreme power archetype. Rome had emperors in togas, the Gilded Age had steel and railroad barons and the Cold War had nuclear-armed statesmen. The artificial intelligence age belongs to a tight-knit pantheon of middle-aged geeks who have discovered leather jackets, private jets and messiah complexes. Talk about Revenge of the Nerds.

The dramatic tumble from glory of former Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang, after revelations he had an affair with a suspected Chinese spy that raised national security alarm bells, has exposed the sheer scale of his Jesus-like following.
